jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A hou2 hing1 fan5

english.note: Use this when the emphasis is on thrilling or exciting someone rather than simply making them happy.

examples.english: Riding the roller coaster can exhilarate me.
examples.traditional: 坐過山車搞到我好興奮。
examples.jyutping: zo6 gwo3 saan1 ce1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 hing1 fan5
